feeds.title: Argy's Point Of View
feeds.description: Argy Nestor is an art educator, blogger, artist, and connector. The purpose of this blog is to share stories that include innovative ideas, resources, and to celebrate the amazing work going on in Arts Education.

feeds.title: Meanderings of a Maine Artist... Blog
feeds.description: Cynthia Smith, a Maine artist, originally from Connecticut. Taught art at the secondary level for 35 years, retired in 2004. Sculpts in bronze, wood, stone, clay & plaster. Follow her musings about sculpture, technique, media, and the creative process.

feeds.title: Plein Aire in Maine Blog
feeds.description: Renee Lammers lives in Maine painting in Stonington, Acadia, and Monhegan Island. She lives with her husband Robert, four golden retrievers, Monet, Poppy, Lily, and Lady Violet, and two cats. Her blog, Plein Aire in Maine invites viewers to explore her intricate and textured artworks that play with light, color, and metallic surfaces in captivating ways.

feeds.title: Americans Who Tell The Truth Blog
feeds.description: Read up on AWTT updates and what our portrait subjects have been up to. By combining art and other media, AWTT offers resources to inspire a new generation of engaged Americans who will act for the common good, our communities, and the Earth.

feeds.title: TEMPOart
feeds.description: TEMPOart is a non-profit that commissions temporary public art that sparks dialogue, builds community, and inspires our collective imagination. Gather the latest news and notes from TEMPOart's recent activities and events.

feeds.title: Elizabeth Fram Blog
feeds.description: Elizabeth Fram is a talented stitching artist who shares her passion for embroidery and inspires others to explore this intricate and rewarding creative pursuit. Whether you're new to embroidery or a seasoned pro, her blog opens a vibrant window into Fram's artistic mind and passion for this intricate traditional craft.

feeds.title: Wiscasset Art Walk Blog
feeds.description: The Wiscasset Art Walk BLOG documents the art exhibits, musicians, and performers from many mid-coast Maine evenings. Wiscasset Art Walk is a program of Wiscasset Creative Alliance, a 501c3 non-profit accepting tax-deductible gifts on behalf of WAW.

feeds.title: The Art of Bruce
feeds.description: Bruce McMillan enjoys dabbling with watercolors, oils, and pencil sketching. His blog, The Art of Bruce, is a walk through his latest art ramblings, dissecting his process, techniques, and creative inspirations behind each new piece he creates.

feeds.title: The Portland Press Herald » Arts & Entertainment
feeds.description: Follow the latest in entertainment and celebrity coverage at The Press Herald. Your definitive source for news, happenings, and artistic perspectives from the Portland Art scene. The Portland Press Herald is Maine's leading news provider telling the biggest stories and events in Maine.

feeds.title: The Willard Gallery
feeds.description: Browse The Willard Gallery Journal for the latest news from the gallery, interviews with artists, and aesthetic inspiration from around the globe. The Willard Gallery offers an approachable fine art gallery experience in Portland, Maine. By directly connecting new collectors and designers to artists from around the world, The Willard Gallery aims to bring timeless art into the center of homes and daily lives.

feeds.title: Down East Magazine » Arts & Leisure
feeds.description: Down East is a magazine that serves as an authoritative source on all aspects of life and culture in Maine. Down East provides in-depth coverage of Maine's natural attractions, dining destinations, makers and artists, and recreation opportunities, as well as thoughtful analysis of the personalities, trends, and complexities impacting the state.

feeds.title: Down East Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Follow Down East Gallery's blog to learn the latest news, stay up-to-date on upcoming music, film & art events, and view sketches, studies, and experimental work by the gallery's artists. Down East Gallery celebrates the creative life in Maine. Set on a 35-acre farm in midcoast Maine, the gallery exhibits art in the setting of a home, with over 250 paintings and sculptures in an antique farmhouse and post-and-beam barn.

feeds.title: Kathi Peters Art Blog
feeds.description: Categorized as an American Contemporary Impressionist, Kathi Peters' work features contrasting values, bright colors, and design, that heighten the emotional content of her work. Dive into her blog sharing esoteric musings and random paintings from her canvas.

feeds.title: University of Southern Maine » Department of Art
feeds.description: Stay connected with the vibrant artistic community at USM through the Department of Art News page. This is your source for the latest updates, announcements, and stories celebrating the talents and accomplishments of our students, faculty, and alumni. The University of Southern Maine offers over 100 areas of undergraduate and graduate studies.

feeds.title: Ogunquit Museum Blog
feeds.description: Explore the Ogunquit Museum of American Art blog for the latest news, exhibition schedules, artist features, and museum updates. Stay connected with OMAA and learn about our vibrant art community in Ogunquit, Maine.

feeds.title: Maine Inside Out Blog
feeds.description: Maine Inside Out is a 501 © (3) nonprofit organization that creates powerful theater to inform and engage the greater community in dialogue about social change. Catch their latest shows, events, spotlights and performances details in the latest blog posts.

feeds.title: Abbe Museum Blog
feeds.description: Uncover hidden stories and fresh perspectives on the artistic masterpieces in Abbe Museum's collection. Dive deep into the creative process, explore historical influences, and gain a deeper appreciation for the world of art. Stay tuned for upcoming events, art festivals and history walks.

feeds.title: Maine West Fine Arts Blog
feeds.description: A blog featuring student work in the Fine Arts at Maine West High School in Des Plaines, IL. The Maine West Fine Arts Department fosters a vibrant community where students can explore their artistic potential and develop their creative voices.

feeds.title: Island Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Island Institute works to sustain Maine's island and remote coastal communities, and exchanges ideas and experiences to further the sustainability of communities here and elsewhere. Explore their blog to hear from artists and industry experts for insights about the importance of art and craft in Maine and the stories shaping the creative economy.

feeds.title: At Home Abroad Blog » Maine
feeds.description: With a keen eye for observation and years of painting experience, At Home Abroad Blog by David Pearce deconstructs his creative process in a way that is both inspiring and educational for artists of all levels. David Pearce has been a journalist, and artist for 35 years and specializes in watercolors, drawings, and mixed media.

feeds.title: Maine Arts Journal
feeds.description: The Maine Arts Journal: UMVA Quarterly is an ever-changing expression of the Maine arts community as compiled through the lens of the MAJ editorial board and with the support of the Union of Maine Visual Artists. The Union of Maine Visual Artists (UMVA) represents visual artists statewide in all fields of endeavor and welcomes those who support contemporary artists in Maine. The UMVA is dedicated to upholding the dignity of artists while creating positive social change through the arts.

feeds.title: Art New England
feeds.description: Art New England is your one-stop shop for diving into the vibrant art scene of the Northeast. As the region's premier art and culture magazine, it brings you in-depth articles on the latest exhibitions, insightful reviews by leading critics, and profiles of the talented artists shaping New England's creative landscape.

feeds.title: Maine Art Collectors Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with museum and art gallery exhibitions of Maine artists such as Dahlov Ipcar, Tom Crotty, Philip Barter, Alfred Chadborn, Joel Babb, and Neil Welliver. Maineartcollectors.com provides an online marketplace for both new and established collectors to buy and sell fine art by artists with a connection to Maine.

feeds.title: Marie Spaulding Art Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Marie Spaulding's artist blog, where she embarks on a creative journey capturing the beauty of both beloved household pets and the fascinating world of wildlife. Spaulding is an artist deeply passionate about portraying the unique personalities and intricate details of animals through her artwork.

feeds.title: Jamie Hogan Blog
feeds.description: Jamie Hogan draws her inspiration from moonlight, reflections, pink clouds, wishing on the first star, and the raw beauty that is Maine. Watch her artistic talent unfold as she shares random drawings and sketches from her repertoire and whatever she observes in her surroundings.

feeds.title: George Van Hook Blog
feeds.description: George Van Hook paints landscapes and has won numerous competitions for his Plein Air artworks. Through his Art blog, George shares the inspiration behind his artworks, documents his creative process with eye-catching visuals, and announces upcoming exhibitions and sales of his unique art pieces.

feeds.title: Ann Larsen Blog
feeds.description: Ann Larsen is a professional artist who shares her painting expertise through her instructional blog. On this creative platform, Ann offers valuable tips, lessons, and insights to help budding artists develop their skills and unlock their full artistic potential.

feeds.title: Alan Claude Studio Blog
feeds.description: New posts and videos from Alan Claude Studio. Overlooking the Kennebec River, the Alan Claude Gallery is located in historic downtown Gardiner. Alan Claude's Poster Style art of lighthouses, and coastal and lake scenes of Maine and other New England states are boldly displayed in the artist's beautifully restored buildings and gallery.

feeds.title: Elaine From Maine Blog
feeds.description: Elaine Hranich enjoys both plein-air painting and experimenting with multiple mediums including pastels, watercolors, oils, and acrylics. She has her own unique palette knife and color style. See her latest artworks and follow her artistic journey as she shares her thoughts and updates on this blog.

feeds.title: Maine Made Artist Coop Blog
feeds.description: The Lupine Cottage is a co-op of over 65 Maine Artists and Craftspeople. Discover unique Maine Made Products created using only the highest quality materials. Follow this blog for monthly updates on happening at the co-op, new products, promotions, seasonal themes and more.

feeds.title: Sheryl Ann Wing | Maine Artist Blog
feeds.description: Watercolor artist Sheryl Ann Wing spends her free time enjoying and canvassing the outdoors and backwoods of rural Maine. Explore her humble corner on the internet where she displays her latest art, thought and perspectives on her surroundings.

feeds.title: Farnsworth Art Museum Blog
feeds.description: Farnsworth Art Museum celebrates Maine's role in American history by offering a nationally recognized collection of works from many of America's greatest artists. This blog is your behind-the-scenes portal into the rich exhibition programming, extensive collection of American art, and vibrant community engagement at the museum.

feeds.title: The Maine Mag » Arts
feeds.description: Delve into the Arts archives for a deeper, more lively look as Maine's arts community. The Maine Mag champions Maine's creative spirit, showcasing the ingenuity of its people. Through captivating features, travel guides, and restaurant reviews, it unveils the state's unique character.

feeds.title: Maine Art Hill Blog
feeds.description: Maine Art Hill is a premier gallery celebrating over thirty years in business. From oils, acrylics, pastels, watercolors, encaustics, and photography to blown glass, mixed media, and metal sculpture, including the Wind Sculptures by Lyman Whitaker™, there's something for every art lover.

feeds.title: Portland Art Gallery Art Blog
feeds.description: The Portland Art Gallery's art blog 'Art Matters' features enlightening discussions, commentary, and interviews with local artists. Writer Susan Sherrill Axelrod is a seasoned editor and writer whose work covers a broad range of lifestyle subjects-- food and drink, art and design, preservation, and sustainability.
